sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 80 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for physical attacks by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for magic attacks by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 160% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK buff limit by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases your dark elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 30.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Sirius Symbiotic Pair] Revenant & Tail or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
